about_the_game:
Step into the mischievous paws of a brave and curious cat in The Polterquest, a thrilling 3D action-adventure platformer set in eerie, ghost-infested locations! As a fearless feline explorer, you must navigate through haunted mansions, abandoned graveyards, and misty forests, uncovering hidden treasures while avoiding supernatural dangers.

Leap across crumbling platforms, climb eerie structures, and use your feline reflexes to dodge ghostly traps. Solve puzzles to unlock secret passages, outwit mischievous spirits, and harness your cat instincts to reveal hidden pathways. But beware—each haunted location is guarded by powerful spectral entities that will challenge your courage and agility!

With charming cartoon visuals, fast-paced platforming, and a spooky yet whimsical atmosphere, The Polterquest delivers a purr-fect mix of adventure, mystery, and ghostly fun. Can you outsmart the spirits and claim the legendary treasure hidden within the haunted realms?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-2550K, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 7 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 | Radeon HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 or GeForce GTX 1060 | Radeon R9 290X or Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: In Polterquest you play as the "coolcat" exploring haunted places and finding treasures. Game is a 3d action adventure platformer in which you need to solve certain puzzles to progress as well as defeating enemies along your journey.
